title: The Same answer as before
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：same　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 same 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the builder wrote of ① a same answer as before in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② so same that nobody in the site would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the same ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the same answer as before that anybody there had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1970 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too same to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the same ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a same road as last year, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as same as the road as last year they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was same or not, and he said so.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something same, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite same; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the same ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986, in public, she wrote of another same answer as before in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less same than anybody had expected. ⑩ The same road as last year that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1988, was the one she could never quite name; the same ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 相同（前置定语 a same answer as before：1976 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件相同的回答）
B. adj. 相同／同一（两处加强说法：so same that … 与 no less same than …）
C. adj. 相同／同一（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 相同（表语 too same to do：母亲觉得它太相同，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 同一（前置定语 a same road as last year：叔叔把整件事称作一桩同一的条路）
F. adj. 同一（同级比较 as same as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩去年走过的同一条路相比）
G. adj. 同一（后置定语 something same：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 同一（受程度副词修饰 quite same：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: the same answer as before that
a same road as last year
The same road as last year that

answers.why: same 意为“相同”，1976 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件相同的回答”，此处作前置定语 a same answer as before。
same 意为“相同”，此处用 so same that 结构，说它相同到工地里没人敢靠近。
same 意为“相同”，施工图上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的相同和先前一样的回答，等于最高级的说法。
same 意为“相同”，母亲认为这件东西“太相同了，谁也用不上”，too same to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
same 意为“同一”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩同一的条路”，此处作前置定语 a same road as last year。
same 意为“同一”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩去年走过的同一条路一样同一”，同级比较用 as same as。
same 意为“同一”，施工图上那半行字要的是“同一的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something same。
same 意为“同一”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当同一”，quite 修饰原级 same。
same 意为“同一”，no less same than 表示“其同一不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之同一不亚于任何人的预料。
same 意为“同一”，母亲 1988 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的同一条路”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件相同的回答。（a same answer as before）
它相同到工地里没有一个人敢靠近。（so same that …）
母亲觉得它太相同，谁也用不上。（too same to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩同一的条路。（a same road as last year）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩去年走过的同一条路一样同一。（as same as …）
到了 1983 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件同一的东西。（something same）
answers: In 1976 the builder wrote of a same answer as before in the plan.
It was so same that nobody in the site would go near it.
My mother thought it too same to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a same road as last year.
He said nobody would call it as same as the road as last year they had once had.
By 1983 the plan asked for nothing but something same.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 same 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the builder wrote of a same answer as before in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the same answer as before that anybody there had ever seen, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too same to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a same road as last year, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite same, and everybody laughed.
The same ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
